senses.gloss: ष्ठिव् vt. or vi. 1P, 4P (pp. ष्ठ्युत; pres. ष्ठीवति, ष्ठीव्यति) 1. To spit, to eject saliva from the mouth; 2. to sputter, Bt.xii.18.With नि-, 1. to eject, to emit, Bt.xvii.10, xviii.14, R.ii.75, Sak.iv.; 2. to spit, to eject saliva from the mouth, M.v.145.
ष्ठीवन n. 1. The act of spitting; 2. spittle, saliva.
